title: PDF to JPG Converter
description: Convert PDF pages into high-quality JPG images locally in your browser. Extract individual page images or download all as a ZIP.

faqs.question: Can I choose which pages to convert?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can specify a custom page range (e.g. "1, 3-5") or choose to convert all pages of the document.

faqs.question: What image quality options are available?
faqs.answer: You can convert at Standard Quality (1x scale), High Quality (2x scale), or Ultra Quality (3x scale) for high-resolution vector text zoom details.

faqs.question: Is my PDF content uploaded to a server?
faqs.answer: No. The conversion is processed completely locally in your browser. Your private document pages are drawn on local canvas buffers, protecting your confidential information.

educationalContent.whatIsIt: PDF to JPG renders PDF document pages onto HTML5 canvas surfaces and exports them as high-quality JPEG image formats (using pdfjs-dist and JSZip).
educationalContent.howToUse:
1. Select or drag & drop a PDF document.
2. Preview the page thumbnails in the grid.
3. Choose output resolution (Standard, High, Ultra) and page ranges.
4. Click "Convert to Images".
5. Download individual pages as JPEGs or click "Download All (ZIP)" to save all pages.
proTips: For presentations or graphic-heavy PDFs, 2x scale (High Quality) is recommended to keep texts legible.
If you only need a single page, you can click "Download Page" directly on that page thumbnail to save time.
